result: Narrowed; original node status retained. In the formal angle-residue model modulo 2m, for every m>1 the distinct residues 1 and m+1 have the same doubled residue 2. Thus full-braid monodromy alone does not select an exchange residue. At m=3 the two residues are 1 and 4. This is an algebraic ambiguity, not a Berry-phase derivation.
proof_boundary: The statistical exchange phase of Laughlin quasiholes requires the wavefunction, adiabatic transport and Berry connection, plus a branch/continuity convention. The algebraic non-uniqueness does not refute the Arovas-Schrieffer-Wilczek result.
